explanation.dispatchPlanner: Start the planner for this objective.
explanation.ingestPlan: Read the planner result into the objective plan.
explanation.activatePlan: Make the prepared objective plan active.
explanation.dispatchNode: Start an implementation worker for an objective task.
explanation.ingestReport: Read an implementation worker report into the objective state.
explanation.runCheck: Run an acceptance command for the objective.
explanation.dispatchReviewer: Start an independent review of the objective work.
explanation.dispatchIntegrator: Start the final integration review of the objective work.
explanation.ingestVerdict: Read a review verdict into the objective state.
explanation.recordLanding: Record the completed objective work as landed on disk.
explanation.commitLocalBranch: Commit the completed objective work to its local branch.
explanation.pushRef: Push the objective branch to its remote.
explanation.openHostedReview: Open a hosted review for the objective branch.
explanation.rerunCheck: Request another run of the failed hosted check.
explanation.prepareFix: Start a worker to prepare a fix for the failed hosted check.
explanation.publishFix: Publish the prepared check fix to the hosted review branch.
explanation.prepareConflictResolution: Start a worker to prepare a merge-conflict resolution.
explanation.publishConflictResolution: Publish the prepared conflict resolution to the hosted review branch.
explanation.updateBranch: Update the hosted review branch from its base branch.
explanation.enqueue: Enter the hosted review in its merge queue.
explanation.runGate: Run a whole-tree command on the integrated branch before review and landing.
explanation.applyPlanPatch: Apply a planner repair patch to the approved objective plan.
explanation.dispatchPlanReview: Start the plan critic review of a draft revision or a pending patch.
explanation.ingestPlanReview: Read a plan review verdict into the objective state.

owner.title: Owning agent
owner.help: Optional. When set, Heimdall wakes this agent on a deviation instead of replanning automatically. Off keeps automatic replan-on-failure.
owner.harnessUnavailableHelp: Only Claude has a resumable session Heimdall can wake between turns. Other harnesses cannot own a watcher yet.
